title: Nine Rashers and One Pan
subtitle: 食物与烹饪 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 食物与烹饪（生活与自我·饮食与烹饪）
meta: 主题语境：食物与烹饪（生活与自我·饮食与烹饪）　|　核心词汇：bacon　|　正文 310 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bacon 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 my grandmother cooked ① bacon on Sundays for nine years and never ate it herself, which she said was the point. The ② bacon, meaning the meat and not the smell, came from a man who had known her father; bacon, she said, is the only food that announces itself nine rooms away. She said the announcing was the best part of it.

Every ③ bacon in that house came out of the same pan and the same three minutes. Their ④ bacon — the one my grandfather brought home in 1961 — was nine rashers and one argument; bacon, my father said, is the only thing a man can bring home that counts as an apology. He said the argument was about the price.

My uncle said ⑤ bacon was the only English food he trusted, and my aunt said that was because it is barely cooked. The ⑥ bacon, meaning the idea and not the rashers, is nine parts salt and one part habit; bacon, my mother said, is the only food that people describe by the sound it makes. She said the sound is the whole recipe.

By 1968 the ⑦ bacon had become a Friday thing, because the Sunday had become a rush. The ⑧ bacon she kept for me was two rashers, wrapped in paper, in a drawer; bacon, my grandmother said, is the only food that improves by being hidden and eaten cold. She said eleven years of practice had taught her that.

The ⑨ bacon I remember is the Sunday pan, nine rashers of it, which she cooked standing up and never sat down to eat. ⑩ Bacon, she said in 1974, is the only thing in a house that everybody smells and one person pays for; every bacon, she said, is a small luxury that pretends to be a necessity. She said the pretending is what keeps a family quiet.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 培根；咸肉（肉本身）
B. n. 培根（指那块肉，与气味相对）
C. n. 培根（指 1961 年祖父带回家的那九片）
D. 固定搭配：cook bacon 煎培根
E. n. 培根（抽象：指这种食物、这个概念）
F. n. 培根（指变成星期五专属的那一种）
G. n. 培根（指藏在抽屉里、留着的那两片）
H. n. 培根（抽象总称；泛指）

answers.why: cook bacon 意为“煎培根”，1959 年起祖母每个星期天煎培根，煎了九年，自己却从不吃，她说这才是要害。
bacon 指“那块肉”，与气味相对，那些培根来自一个认识她父亲的人。
bacon 意为“培根、咸肉”，那屋里每一份培根都出自同一只锅、同样的三分钟。
bacon 指 1961 年祖父带回家的那九片，那九片培根带回了一场争吵。
bacon 为抽象总称，泛指“培根这种食物”，叔叔说培根是他唯一信得过的英国食物。
bacon 意为“培根这个概念”，与那些肉片相对，是九分盐加一分习惯。
bacon 指变成星期五专属的那一种，到 1968 年培根成了星期五的东西，因为星期天已经变忙了。
bacon 指藏在抽屉里、留着的那两片，她给我留的培根是两片，用纸包着，放在抽屉里。
bacon 意为“培根”，我记得的是星期天那一锅，九片培根，她站着煎，却从来没坐下来吃过。
bacon 为抽象总称，她说培根是屋里唯一人人都闻得到、却只有一个人付钱的东西。
